title: my skills, post-AI
caption:
a skills assessment nobody asked for.

writing code: 12%. reading code I didn't write: 94%.
remembering syntax: gone. writing prompts: honestly a craft now.
explaining my own pull request: 21%, "it's… doing a thing."

which skill of yours went up, and which one quietly left?

slide.kicker: I’m a code reviewer now, apparently
